subject: Mid-window OKR signal review + nominations for ops dependencies
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-window OKR signal review + nominations for ops dependencies

Team —

Quick mid-window pulse. I pulled together the first-pass signals for the OKRs we own in Q3 and flagged where we need commitments or decisions to stay on track before QBR prep week. Key asks below; I captured more detail in the attached dependency matrix.

Top signals (short):
- Serving runtime: latency 95th at +18% vs target this sprint (batching regressions on 2s seq).
- Dedicated rollout: two customer migrations queued but infra reservations are missing (GC nodes).
- Optimize recommendations: quantization tests look promising but need a validation run on prod-sim to confirm no quality regressions.

Critical dependency asks (nominations needed by EOD Tue):
1) Network/infra: nominate owner to coordinate GC node reservations and capacity bump for two Dedicated migrations (estimate 8 GPU-days).
2) QE/Perf: owner to run 24h prod-sim validation for top 3 quantized models and turn around results in 48h.
3) Sales/CS: confirm go/no-go for Nebula AI POC (S. Moreno) by Wed so we can prioritize compute for their migration.

Attachments: dependency_matrix_2026-08-22.xlsx (matrix + impact), QBR_draft_v1.pdf (working deck).

Please reply with a single-line nomination (name + short ETA) for each ask. I will collate and escalate any unfilled ones to leadership.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Director, Serving Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-window OKR signal review + nominations for ops dependencies

Diego —

Ack and thanks for the summary + matrix. Quick nominations from my side:
- Network/infra (GC node reservations): Laura Bennett to coordinate with CloudOps; can commit to locking reservations by Mon 24 Aug EOD (will need 4 additional GPUs allocated immediately, rest next week).
- QE/Perf validation: Monica will lead the prod-sim validation (see cc) — Monica, can you confirm 48h turnaround?
- Sales/CS confirmation for Nebula AI: looping in Vivek for customer cadence

I made a few comments on the deck (QBR_draft_v1.pdf) — slide 3 has an alternative framing for the latency story that I think will sit better with execs.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Mid-window OKR signal review + nominations for ops dependencies

On Sat, Aug 22, 2026 at 11:03 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> - QE/Perf validation: Monica will lead the prod-sim validation (see cc) — Monica, can you confirm 48h turnaround?

Yes — I can lead this. Plan: spin up prod-sim cluster Monday morning, run the top-3 quantization candidates across the standard prompt set ~72 hours (I want the extra day for tail cases), and produce a short report with signal breakdowns (latency, perplexity, failures). Owner: Monica Patel. Deliverable ETA: Thu 27 Aug 10:00 PT (report + artifacts). If ops can reserve the 8 GPU-days earlier we can compress to Wed.

Attachments: service-priority-requests.txt (short list of services that will be impacted if we pull GPUs).

Monica
Monica Patel
Staff SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Moreno <sofia.moreno@nebula.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-window OKR signal review + nominations for ops dependencies

Diego / team —

Quick update on the customer front: I chatted with Sofia (Nebula AI) this morning. They are keen to proceed but procurement needs a slot for an expedited security review. Sofia says they can commit to an initial migration in the week of 8/31 if we can guarantee Dedicated capacity and a short security attestation. I told her we'd aim to confirm by Wed.

Action items on my side:
- I will send a short customer memo (1-pager) to Procurement and CS by EOD Mon to summarize needs and propose the Dedicated slot.
- For Nebula POC, propose we allocate the first 2 GPU-days from the 8 GPU-days pool; remaining 6 for production migration the week of 8/31.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Thanks all — good progress and appreciate the quick nominations. Short summary + next steps (I will surface any gaps in Tuesday leadership readout):

Summary of owners / ETAs:
- GC node reservations: Laura Bennett -> lock 4 GPUs Mon 24 Aug EOD; remaining 4 by Tue 25 Aug EOD.
- Prod-sim quantization validation: Monica Patel -> report Thu 27 Aug 10:00 PT (will try to move earlier if GPUs available).
- Customer confirmation (Nebula AI): Vivek Kulkarni -> customer memo sent; target confirm Wed 26 Aug.

Open / escalations:
- If GC reservations miss Tue EOD, I will escalate to infra leadership for immediate allocation (we cannot slip the Dedicated migrations).
- Please review and accept the few deck edits in QBR_draft_v1.pdf — I plan to circulate the leadership readout version on Thu morning.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Director, Serving Platform
